scenario: LFAC.1.7 key=∅ singleton (latest wins). An all-`mutable` logical schema has an empty identity key, so it holds exactly one live fact: re-asserting an identical reading coalesces (no re-fire, LLOG.2.7.1); a changed reading supersedes the prior one (one live fact, re-fires). Pin: assert reading=1, assert reading=1 (identical → coalesce), assert reading=2 (supersede) → two `warm` firings (not three — an accumulating schema would fire on the identical re-assert). The changing slot is `reading` and not `ts`: `ts` is outside the no-op test ([LFAC.9.1]), so a change to it alone would coalesce.
rules_ds:
schema AmbientTemp scope logical:
    reading: Float mutable
    celsius: Float mutable

rule warm:
    AmbientTemp a where a.celsius > 20.0
->
    log info "warm"
